correctness.rationale: For ordered r-set S of indegree-zero vertices, event no arrow lands in S has probability ((n-r)/n)^n. Conditional arrows restricted to T=[n]\S remain IID uniform T, giving a uniform (n-r)-mapping and leaving all original directed cycles in T; sum over S gives exact factorial-moment identity and bivariate pgf, including vector cycle counts. E C_(n,k)=(n)_k/(k n^k) yields cycle-specific and full covariance formulas, with strict monotone in n for k>=2 and equality k=1. For monotone h, cyclic-vertex survival Pr(K_m>=j)=(m)_j/m^j is monotone in m, and given K_m=j cycle count is uniform-permutation cycle count with Bernoulli(1/i) coupling. The displayed gaussian comparison and dominated Riemann-sum show n(a_n-a_(n-1))->1/2, hence covariance->-1/(2e). Independently enumerated *all* n^n maps at n=2,3,4,5 by separate functional traversal, recovering exact covariances -1/8,-34/243,-1203/8192,-295176/1953125; independently rational-computed all n=2..10. Finite enumeration does not prove the asymptotic.
